user.title: Connect to your Sony device
user.description: Turn on the Sony device and enable remote access. Use an IP address or hostname without a URL scheme. Leave the PIN empty to request a new PIN on the TV.

pin.title: Pair your Sony device
pin.description: Enter the PIN shown on the TV connected to the Sony device.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair your Sony device again
reauth_confirm.description: Turn on the Sony device and enable remote access. Continue to request a new PIN on the TV.

discovery_confirm.title: Set up discovered Sony device
discovery_confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Turn on the Sony device and enable remote access. Continue to pair it; a PIN may appear on the connected TV.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the address, ports, network and remote access settings.
error.invalid_auth: The PIN was rejected. Enter the PIN shown on the TV.
error.invalid_host: Enter an IP address or hostname without a scheme, port or path.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.wrong_device: This address belongs to a different Sony device.

abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the discovered Sony device.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The device did not advertise a supported description URL or valid address.
abort.not_configured: This MAC address does not belong to a configured Sony device.
abort.unknown: Unexpected discovery error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
